chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-'Attar (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah, from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi, from Sharif b. Sabiq al-Taflisi, from Ibrahim b. Muhammad, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Isa b. Maryam (peace be upon him) passed by a grave whose occupant was being punished. Then, he passed by it the following year, and behold, he was not being punished. So he said: O my Lord! I passed by this grave last year and its occupant was being punished, then I passed by it this year and he is not being punished! So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: O Spirit of Allah! A righteous son has grown up for him, who rectified a path and sheltered an orphan, so I forgave him due to what his son had done.

He said: And Isa b. Maryam (peace be upon him) said to Yahya b. Zakariyya (peace be upon him): If something that is truly in you is said about you, then know that it is a sin you have been reminded of, so seek Allah's forgiveness for it. And if something that is not in you is said about you, then know that it is a good deed recorded for you without you having toiled for it.

key_terms.حسنة كتبت لك: A good deed recorded for you -- a reward credited without any effort on one's part
key_terms.روح الله: Spirit of Allah -- a Quranic title for Prophet Isa (Jesus), reflecting his creation by Allah's command
key_terms.يعذب صاحبه: Its occupant was being punished -- refers to the punishment of the grave (adhab al-qabr)

ai.seo_question: What did Isa (Jesus) say about the grave whose punishment ceased, and what advice did he give Yahya (John) about people speaking about you?
ai.summary: This Prophetic hadith contains two teachings attributed to Isa b. Maryam (Jesus). First, the story of a grave whose punishment ceased after the deceased's righteous son repaired a road and sheltered an orphan, showing that children's good deeds can benefit their parents even after death. Second, Isa's advice to Yahya (John) about how to respond to people speaking about you: true criticism is a reminder of sin requiring repentance, while false accusations earn you reward without effort.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Sharif b. Sabiq al-Taflisi from Ibrahim b. Muhammad from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

`Isa b. Maryam (as) passed by a grave whose occupant was being punished. Then, he passed by it again the following year, and he was not being punished. So, he said: “O Lord! I passed by this grave last year, and its occupant was being punished. Then, I passed by it this year, and I found that he was not being punished.” So, Allah revealed to him: “O Spirit of Allah! He has a righteous son who rectified a path and sheltered an orphan, so he was forgiven due to what his son had done.”

He said: `Isa b. Maryam (as) said to Yahya b. Zakariyya (as): If something true [of evil] is said about you, then know that it is a sin, so ask for Allah’s forgiveness for it. If something false is said about you, then know that a good deed will be recorded for you without needing to toil for it.
